Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of XOM.
Our gross margin expanded by 178 basis points to 66.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2022.
We generated $19.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 785 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Revenue guidance of $9.6 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
